metadata.description: Curated, deduplicated skills, agents, workflows and rules for AI agents, one plugin per domain.

plugins.name: principles
plugins.description: Always-on coding behaviour for agents - simplicity, surgical changes, explicit assumptions, verifiable success criteria.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Delivery lifecycle - ideation, specs, plans, execution, worktrees, branch completion, handoff, retrospectives, tickets.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: System and code design - modules, domain models, ADRs, APIs, boundaries.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Evaluating and improving existing code - giving and receiving review, simplification, refactoring, debt, repository audits.

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Proving behaviour - TDD, test strategy, end-to-end and browser testing, verification before completion.

plugins.name: debugging
plugins.description: Finding the cause of failures - diagnosis, build errors, silent failures.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Application and agent security - audits, threat modelling, secrets, supply chain, hardening.

plugins.name: languages
plugins.description: Idiomatic knowledge per programming language and framework, one pack per language.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: Databases, migrations, data modelling and data engineering.

plugins.name: ui
plugins.description: Visual interface - aesthetic direction, typography, colour, layout, tokens, design systems, components, finish.

plugins.name: ux
plugins.description: User experience - user research, flows, information architecture, usability heuristics, microcopy.

plugins.name: accessibility
plugins.description: Accessibility conformance and audits - WCAG, ARIA, assistive technology.

plugins.name: brand
plugins.description: Brand identity, voice and style guides.

plugins.name: creative-media
plugins.description: Visual pieces and media - banners, slides, generative art, GIFs, images.

plugins.name: ai-engineering
plugins.description: Building products with LLMs - model APIs, MCP servers, RAG, prompts, product evals, cost.

plugins.name: agent-engineering
plugins.description: Configuring and operating coding agents - skill authoring, harnesses, orchestration, subagents, loops, memory, context.

plugins.name: platform
plugins.description: Git and GitHub, CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, SRE, incidents.

plugins.name: documents
plugins.description: Office documents and technical or corporate writing.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Source-backed research with citations, literature reviews.

plugins.name: science
plugins.description: Computational science - omics, chemistry, simulation, study design and statistics, scientific writing, biomedical research data, lab automation.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product management - PRDs, prioritisation, feedback synthesis, experiments.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: SEO and answer-engine optimisation, content, social, email, paid media.

plugins.name: sales
plugins.description: Prospecting, qualification, proposals, pipeline.

plugins.name: finance
plugins.description: Bookkeeping, FP&A, pricing, tax.

plugins.name: legal-compliance
plugins.description: Contracts, regulatory compliance, legal privacy.

plugins.name: operations
plugins.description: Project management, people operations, customer support, processes.

plugins.name: games
plugins.description: Game design and engineering - mechanics, progression, economies, levels, engine integration, runtime performance and multiplayer.

plugins.name: geospatial
plugins.description: Geographic information - spatial analysis, coordinate systems, cartography, GIS data pipelines and spatial services.

plugins.name: extended-reality
plugins.description: Immersive AR/VR/XR applications - reference spaces, tracked input, spatial interaction, comfort and device/runtime verification.

plugins.name: healthcare
plugins.description: Health systems and clinician-reviewed support - interoperability, traceable evidence briefs and documentation of verified clinical facts and decisions.

plugins.name: web3
plugins.description: Blockchain and DeFi engineering - smart contracts, token/accounting units, mechanism invariants and local verification; no investment recommendations or live transactions.

plugins.name: infrastructure
plugins.description: Networks and self-hosted labs - connectivity, routing, DNS, VPN, segmentation, local services, storage and recovery; application delivery stays in platform.

plugins.name: logistics
plugins.description: Physical supply chains - replenishment, suppliers, transport/carriers, shipment exceptions and reverse logistics.
